2609.29807.title: CORDIAL: Calibrating Ordinal LLM Outputs from Few Labels
2609.29807.paper_summary: A large language model (LLM) can turn a text into a distribution over an ordered scale, but that distribution is a noisy measurement: saturated, compressed or exaggerated, and biased in a consistent direction. We propose CORDIAL, which treats the model's output as a noisy reading of the true label and corrects it with a channel of five interpretable parameters. The channel is small enough for its posterior to be averaged from a handful of labels, and we prove that the resulting calibration preserves first-order stochastic order. On Amazon reviews and CMU-MOSEI transcripts with four LLMs, CORDIAL has the lowest log loss among nine calibrators in 76 of 80 settings with 5 to 100 labels; with 20 labels and the main 7B reader, it matches the strongest baseline using 28-54 labels. The same posterior lets us learn priors from other tasks and fuse several LLMs. Unrestricted calibrators such as Dirichlet calibration overtake it only as the calibration set grows into the hundreds or thousands.
2609.29807.paper_summary_zh: 一個大型語言模型（LLM）可以將文本轉換為有序尺度上的分佈，但該分佈是一種嘈雜的測量：飽和、壓縮或誇大，並且在一致的方向上存在偏差。我們提出了 CORDIAL，將模型的輸出視為對真實標籤的嘈雜讀取，並通過五個可解釋的參數進行修正。這個通道足夠小，以至於其後驗可以從少數標籤中進行平均，我們證明了所得到的校準保持了一階隨機順序。在亞馬遜評論和 CMU-MOSEI 轉錄本中，使用四個 LLM，CORDIAL 在 80 個設置中的 76 個中擁有最低的對數損失，這些設置有 5 到 100 個標籤；在 20 個標籤和主要的 7B 閱讀器下，它與使用 28-54 標籤的最強基線相匹配。同樣的後驗讓我們能夠從其他任務中學習先驗並融合幾個 LLM。無限制的校準器，如 Dirichlet 校準，僅在校準集增長到數百或數千時超越它。
